name: InviteDialog
description: A dialog for inviting one or many people: rows of email and role, Add another, checks for format, duplicates and people who are already members, an error summary, and a submit button that says how many invitations it sends. Your onInvite does the work. UI permission is not security: the server must check again.

roles.tsType: Array<{ id: string; label: string; description?: string }>
roles.description: The roles a person can be invited as. The description of the chosen role is shown under its Select.

defaultRole.description: The id of the role each new row starts with. Defaults to the first role.

existingEmails.description: Emails that are already members. Typing one is an error on that row. Compared without case.

maxInvites.description: The most rows one send can hold. Add another is disabled at the limit and says so.

title.description: The dialog's title, shown as its heading.

showMessage.description: Shows an optional message field that goes with every invitation.

messageLabel.description: The label of the message field.

submitLabel.description: The text of the submit button for a number of invitations. Default: "Send invitation" and "Send 3 invitations".

successMessage.description: The status message announced once the dialog has closed after a send. Default: "3 invitations sent".

onInvite.tsType: (invites: Array<{ email: string; role: string }>, details: { message?: string }) => void | import("../form/form").SubmitResult | Promise<void | import("../form/form").SubmitResult>
onInvite.description: Sends the invitations; yours, async. Resolve for success. Return { fieldErrors: { "invites[1].email": "..." } } to show a problem on a row, or { formError } for the whole form; a throw also keeps the dialog open.

onCancel.description: Called when the person cancels: the Cancel button or Escape.

onOpenChange.description: Called with false when the dialog closes after a cancel or a successful send. Needed with isOpen.

isOpen.description: Controlled open state, for a dialog opened without a DialogTrigger.

permissions.description: What the app allows: invite. Hidden renders nothing; disabled keeps the dialog but the submit button stays focusable with aria-disabled and the reason shown and read, and nothing is sent. This only changes what people see: the server must check again.

classNames.description: Extra class names for single parts, so you can restyle one part without editing the file. Keys: dialog, form, list, message, actions, cancelButton, submitButton, reason, status.

keyboard: Tab: moves through the rows, Add another, the message, Cancel and the submit button; focus stays inside the dialog
Enter in an email field: sends
Each row has buttons to move it, insert below and remove it, all reachable by Tab
requirements: Focus lands on the first email field when the dialog opens
After a send that worked the dialog closes and focus returns to the control that opened it
A failed send keeps the dialog open and moves focus to the error summary; each item moves to its field
Row errors are linked to their field with aria-describedby and aria-invalid
Adding and removing a row is announced; a status message tells the result after the dialog closes
A disabled invite stays focusable and the reason is its description
screenReader: "3 invitations sent" after the dialog closes

use_when: Inviting people to a team, workspace or account by email, one or many at a time
avoid_when: Adding a user with a full profile: use UserForm
Importing hundreds of people: use a file import flow
anti_patterns: Treating the permissions prop as protection: UI permission is not security, so the server must check again
Sending the invitations from inside the component: onInvite is yours
Closing the dialog yourself after a failed onInvite: it stays open on purpose so the person can fix the rows

contract.data: The roles people can be invited as, the emails of existing members, and an async onInvite that does the sending.
customization: title, description, messageLabel, submitLabel and successMessage
works inside DialogTrigger or controlled with isOpen
